history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration develop a clear policy guide on spendable rental income and specify the purpose, standards and methodology for calculation of the retention of spendable revenue, as well as its usage, scope and oversight.
history.administration_response: The Administration convened a working group in 2025 to collect and review the different rental practices in the major entities. While the original target was to finalize the policy guidance by the end of 2025, this process has required more time, due to additional tasks and competing priorities in the second half of 2025. The Administration is currently reviewing a first draft of the guidance and aims to complete the document by the end of June 2026.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration is still in the process of reviewing the different rental practices in the major entities, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
